body: The wound is public, in career and standing; you may feel illegitimate or exposed in your role.
business: You mentor others toward earned authority, having doubted your own.
shadow: Overbuilding status to cover the wound, or sabotaging your own visibility.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
